Opened from the gift of Sharpness.|Former Inventory Description}} |-|Original = {{QuoteBox|A trophy tower, opened from the Gift of Sharpness.|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Archer''', formerly known as the '''Holiday Archer''', is a tower that attacks enemies with a bow. It could have been unlocked from the [[Event Store|Gift of Sharpness]], which costed {{Tickets|2,500}}, as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. The gift could have also been bought via a limited time gamepass for {{Robux|250}}. It could later be bought through a different limited time gamepass, which was sold multiple times. The '''Archer''' shoots arrows that damage and pierce through enemies, making the '''Archer''' a multi-target tower. The firerate of the '''Archer''' is separated into two halves. The first half is the '''Archer''' loading the bow with an arrow. This can happen even if there are no enemies in the '''Archer's''' range. If it starts attacking with its bow loaded, its firerate will be effectively halved for that shot. The second half is the '''Archer''' aiming the bow, and then firing it. This can only happen if there are enemies in its range, unlike the first half. It also boasts a very high range, despite its very low cost. The arrows it fires will be shot in a straight line. However, if the arrow hits an enemy, it can bounce to another enemy if it is in an ~10 stud radius from the hit enemy. This allows the arrow to change its trajectory and extend how far it goes, making it far more effective at clearing out enemies. If there is no enemy in that range, the arrow will not change directions. The direction of the bounce depends on the enemies. If there are only enemies at the front, it will bounce to the front, if there are only enemies at the back, it will bounce to the back. Meanwhile, if enemies are on both the front and the back, it will be capable of going either way. At Level 3, the '''Archer''' gains the ability to equip different arrows, with the default arrows being replaced by fire arrows at Level 3. These set an enemy on fire, as long as it does not have the [[Burn Immunity]]. At Level 4, it can now swap to explosive arrow, which create an explosion upon hitting a single enemy, meaning its piercing is replaced by an explosion which deals damage on top of the arrow. The final arrow is an shock arrow, which stuns enemies for a brief period of time. There is a 10 second cooldown before arrows can be switched again. The main drawback of this tower is that arrows are projectile-based and will take a short time to reach their intended location. The '''Archer''' can detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies at Level 2+. It can also damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies at Level 3+ with its flame arrows, though only burn damage can damage them, or through its explosions. The '''Archer''' has a placement limit of 15 per player. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Eagle Eye|Cost = {{Money|250}}|Image = [[File:ArcherUpgrade1.png|100px]]|Information = [[Valentines Crate]] |[[Spooky Crate]] |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |- ! |[[File:IceSoulArcherIconIG.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Christmas2025|Ice Soul}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Common}} |- !Daily Store Cost |N/A |- !Obtained From |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *Due to its cheap cost, '''Archers''' can be useful early on during the game. *The '''Archer's''' arrow is quite accurate, as it will hit the intended target every single time. *Due to the '''Archer's''' arrows bouncing from enemies, the exact placement of the tower is not nearly as important as for other projectile towers like the [[Harvester]] or [[Frost Blaster]]. **It can however still help, as the bouncing benefits from compact path layouts. Such maps include [[Simplicity]] and [[Harbor]], as the paths on there are relatively close to each other. *Natural obstacles, such as hills, do not interfere with the '''Archer's''' arrow; it passes right through them. *At Level 3+, the arrows fired by the '''Archer''' will gain the ability to set enemies on fire, if set to flame arrows. **This can allow it to deal more DPS to each enemy hit. It also has the highest max hits, allowing it to hit more enemies than the other arrows in most cases. **Do note that the burn damage cannot be applied to enemies with [[Burn Immunity]], making the '''Archer''' weaker against them. **The '''Archer's''' burn damage does not stack with other '''Archers''' or with towers that deal burn damage, like the [[Pyromancer]]. ***This may hinder some towers' performance, such as the [[Golden Pyromancer]], in which the burning damage dealt is superior compared to that of the '''Archer'''. ***Because flame arrows do not stack with other '''Archers''', it is recommended to only have one or a few '''Archers''' with flame arrows, with the rest using different arrows. *At Level 5, it gains the shock arrows, which can stun enemies. **While the shock is quite short, it can still be useful at stunning if the arrows do not hit the enemy at the same time, but instead hit them separately, applying the stun multiple times and keeping the enemy stunned for a long time, though this can be tricky to pull off. **If an enemy has the [[Stun Immunity]], it will not be stunned but instead only slowed down. For [[Boss]]es, they do get slowed down, but the slowdown is weaker on them. *At Level 4+, it gains the explosive arrows, which explode upon hitting the first enemy. **The explosion does not replace the arrow damage, meaning the explosive arrow are actually quite effective against single target enemies. It also bypasses defense with its explosion, making it useful against high health defense enemies like the [[Fallen Hero]]. ==Trivia== *This tower could have been a reference to [[wp:Robin Hood|Robin Hood]]. This may also have been based on the exclusive [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Archer|Archer]] tower from ''Tower Battles''. *When [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] was initially released, the '''Archer''' was available for {{Coins|1}} if you did not have it. *When initially released, the '''Archer''' could pierce through infinite enemies so long as they were within its range. **This was changed on the 4th of March 2020. Now, it can only pierce through a limited number of enemies. *After the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Archer''' supposedly had "special arrows" between Level 4-5. This supposedly gave arrows the ability to inflict an effect on enemies (such as stuns and explosions). **However, this was only available for special skins that were not yet made. It was then promptly removed in the next update. **One of the special arrow effects would later return on the 7th of April 2023, with flame arrows that inflict burn damage, and another two more on the 15th of January 2025, with arrows that explode and stun enemies on impact. *The '''Archer's''' Level 5 upgrade name, ''Shot of the Century'', is named after an ability name given to [[The Umbra]] on the Tower Defense Simulator Wiki. **This, in turn, is named after the phrase "[[wp:Shot_heard_round_the_world|shot heard round the world]]" by Ralph Waldo Emerson, in the context of the [[wp:Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand|assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand]] leading to [[wp:World War I|World War I]] and indirectly leading to most 20th century conflicts. ==Update
